Below the rule, a centred heading in capitals and a second line "quitatis Pseudapostolo." then a poem of 6 stanzas with a large initial I. Then a centred "EIDEM," and a title line "Vbiquitatis faberrimo fabro." followed by a poem with a large initial N. A signature-like "E i-" at the lower right. Notes: none in the margins.

main_text.p: Quàm lingua modo quod simul perempta
main_text.head: IACOBO ANDREÆ, VBIquitatis Pseudapostolo.
main_text.p: ILLE faber, verifemper simul hoftis & Artis, Qua verum monstrat cum ratione loqui, Ille tacens nunquam, nunquam ratione loquutus, Et celebris sola garrulitate faber:
Hic tandem (o Nemesin!) tot vnus nescius annos Arte docente loqui, morte iubente tacet. Fac sapiant, aut sic taceat, Deus Optime, quotquot Hunc simili referunt garrulitate fabrum.
main_text.head: Vbiquitatis faberrimo fabro.
main_text.p: NE mirere sonet fabri si nomen vbique: Nil vnum norat praeter VBIQVE faber. Dijferuit, docuit, scripfit, volitauit vbique, Atque pios nigro sparfit vbique fale. Hinc male qui Doctos carbone notauit vbique, Est carbone suo notus vbique faber.

page.notes: Printed text transcribed as read. Doubtful readings: the first line of the lower poem "NE mirere sonet" and "Dijferuit", "sparfit", "Est carbone suo notus", and the Greek-free verse lines are readable from a small scan; the top four lines (Pica garrulior...) are italic and may contain small errors. Line "Ille tacens nunquam, nunquam ratione loquutus" has the word "nunquam" printed twice as shown; "Hic tandem (o Nemesin!)" is read with a parenthesis as printed. Some words in the first poem's second stanza are uncertain and not marked, as the scan is faint there. The heading word "VBIquitatis" is set with the large initial "VBI" in capitals.
